findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:283` defines the adjacent open-half-line predicate as `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi`, while grep finds the new `IsClosedCompletelyMonotone` at `Basic.lean:372` and dependent public names at `Basic.lean:377`, `LaplaceRepresentation.lean:555`, and `BernsteinTheorem.lean:314`; Mathlib naming describes predicates by their conclusion and existing adjacent terminology takes precedence.
findings.fix: Rename it to `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIci` and consistently rename `isClosedCompletelyMonotone_iff`, `exists_representsLaplace_of_isClosedCompletelyMonotone`, and `isClosedCompletelyMonotone_laplaceTransform`.
findings.issue: `IsClosedCompletelyMonotone` reads as “closed” modifying the property, not complete monotonicity on a closed interval; it also breaks the adjacent `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` naming pattern.

summary: The new closed-half-line predicate uses nonstandard terminology inconsistent with the adjacent interval-indexed API.
